shared_elements: framed rectangular field with a border
justification: Both show profile human figures in shallow incised relief holding elongated objects within a bordered field, and both combine figures with small sign-like marks, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a horizontal narrative frieze of a chariot with harnessed horses attacking collapsing lions, while B is a vertical arched panel with two figures standing quietly on either side of a central inscribed axis under a curved canopy motif — utterly different scene types and compositional logic.
